pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed polygonal regions with distinct stellate or serrated margins. Edges show sharp pixel-level transitions from medium-brown to cream, with many patches exhibiting 4-6 primary vertex-like extensions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored interstitial pathways of medium pixel thickness relative to patch size. Network topology consists of clear 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathways maintain consistent continuity across the mid-flank and lateral neck surfaces.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency fringe visible along the dorsal neck line, presenting as a dense, dark brown silhouette against the sky and background vegetation.
